title: Colnago Bets Against the Massive Tire Trend With the Stretched G5-X
content:
The brand's new gravel race platform ditches its cyclocross roots, dropping the bottom bracket and extending the wheelbase to conquer Unbound and Badlands.

Read the full article at Colnago Bets Against the Massive Tire Trend With the Stretched G5-X on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
